videos.t: 8mm NASA Apollo 11 Film Projection + Prophet 6 Soundtrack
videos.desc:
Clips from a Kodascope Eight-500 projection of silent 8mm film “Apollo 11: the first men on the Moon”.

Overlayed with an interpretation of Max Richter’s “On the Nature of Daylight” played on a Sequential Prophet 6. An experiment in sending free sheet music through a synthesiser via MIDI with realtime knob twiddling.

The film was originally in full colour. It’s red because the chemicals used in 1969 for the green and blue layers were unstable and have deteriorated over time. 

Music available for free on Bandcamp.

https://hackmodular.bandcamp.com/track/on-the-nature-of-daylight

videos.desc:
A Eurorack panel inspired by the display of the Apollo Guidance Computer that took man to the moon.

The DSKY panel is backlit, replicating the beautiful electroluminescent glow of the original displays. This is done with three LED boards that plug directly into your Eurorack power bus - included fully assembled with each panel. Each LED can be aimed to achieve even lighting of the panel.

The panel is available in two variations:

Lamp Test - this shows all of the segments lit, as they would be after command VERB 35 ENTR

1202 Alarm - this is how Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin saw the infamou
